items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: And Milt Hinton. Ray Brown, Percy Heath, those are the guys I was listening at when I was out here playing man.

ctx.x: That's when I first heard him. And I was sitting in the back of the room and I listened at this boy play for the rest of the night. I couldn't believe it. He was 18 then and as he grow older, he really developed. But you know another thing man, you take a man like him and say well who influenced you in your playing in an interview and he'd say okay Paul Chambers and Sam Jones. Here's man that got nerve enough to say these things. He said Paul Chambers, Sam Jones and Ray Brown where he named three. But you guys,…

I was this and that and so on and so on and so on, lying like a dog, man. Boy, someone had to influence you in playing. So when they ask me, man, I hurry to tell t hem man, Oscar Pettiford, man. That's where I'm coming from. And Milt Hinton. Ray Brown, Percy Heath, those are the guys I was listening at when I was out here playing man. But most of all, where I was really coming from is I was preparing, you see.
Uh huh, uh huh. There are a lot of these scared people though that are afraid. They feel it takes something away from them individually. Their egos be so fragile.
